title: Disk of runner “{{name}}”
lead: How much space Studio images, the build cache and project working copies take on the runner's machine, and what of it can be freed.
loadFailed: Could not load the runner's disk.
notFound: Runner not found: it may have been revoked.
measuring: The runner is measuring its disk…
noReport: The runner has not sent a measurement yet.
noReportHint: Press “Refresh”: the runner measures its disk and reports back, usually within a minute.

old.title: Old versions
old.hint: Images of earlier Studio versions and outdated service tags. The current version and the previous one (for rollback) are kept; anything removed is downloaded again when needed.
old.rollbackAdminHint: Only the owner can remove the previous version of a personal runner.

unused.title: Unused images
unused.hint: Studio images the runner does not need and no container uses. They are downloaded again when needed.
unused.truncated: Only the largest are listed; the total covers all of them.

stopped.title: Stopped Studio containers
stopped.hint: Removed only together with everything else, with “Clean up everything”.

runnerCache.title: Runner cache
runnerCache.hint: Project files the runner downloaded for builds. Builds running now are not affected; the next ones download what they need again.

volumes.title: Volumes
volumes.hint: Volumes are never removed: they hold the TeX Live cache and downloaded models, and without them the next builds take noticeably longer.

cleanAllHint: Everything listed above except the previous version and volumes.
cleanAllHintCache: Only the runner cache: images are not cleaned up here.
nothingToClean: Nothing to free: the runner keeps only what it needs.

confirm.title: Clean up runner “{{name}}”?
confirm.body: Only what is listed below is removed. Active images, running containers, volumes and the previous version are not touched.
confirm.targetBody: Only what is listed below is removed. Anything removed is downloaded again when needed.
confirm.rollbackHint: You will not be able to roll back to it without downloading it again.
confirm.runnerCacheNote: Files touched in the last 10 minutes and working copies used by builds stay.
confirm.personal: The runner's owner will be notified about the cleanup.

job.waiting: Waiting for the runner: it starts the cleanup as soon as it picks up the command.
job.cancelling: Stopping after the current step. {{size}} freed
job.expired: The runner did not pick up the command within 10 minutes. Check that it is online and try again.
job.lost: The runner went away during the cleanup. The next measurement will show what was removed.

outdated.title: Update the runner to see its disk
outdated.body: Runner version {{version}} cannot report disk usage. The disk appears after an update.
outdated.bodyUnknown: This runner version cannot report disk usage. The disk appears after an update.

kubernetes.title: Kubernetes cleans the images on its nodes
kubernetes.body: The runner works in Kubernetes, so only its cache and working copies are shown here. TeX Live images live on the cluster nodes, and Kubernetes removes them itself when a node runs low on space. Studio does not need access to the nodes for that and does not ask for it.

desktop.body: This is a local Studio. Images on this computer are cleaned up in Studio itself: Settings, “Disk”.

dockerUnavailable: The runner could not reach Docker: images cannot be counted.
offline: The runner has been offline since {{when}}. The last measurement is shown; you can clean up when the runner is back.
offlineNever: The runner is offline. You can clean up when it is back.
personal: This is a personal runner. The owner ({{owner}}) will be notified about the cleanup; only they can remove the previous version.

failure.unknown: That did not work. Please try again.
failure.network: The server did not respond. Check the connection and try again.

auto.title: Automatic cleanup
auto.hint: Dangling layers, the Docker build cache and old image versions, when the runner data volume has less free space than the threshold. The current and previous versions of the Studio and TeX Live stay, running builds are not affected. At most once every {{minutes}} min.
auto.lastNever: Automatic cleanup has not run yet
auto.lastCancelled: Automatic cleanup: last run {{when}}, stopped, freed {{size}}
auto.lastError: Automatic cleanup: last run {{when}}, with errors, freed {{size}}
auto.lastLost: Automatic cleanup: last run {{when}}, the runner went away during the cleanup

reason.outdated: Automatic cleanup becomes available after the runner is updated to {{version}}. You can save the setting in advance.
reason.kubernetes: Automatic cleanup is not needed: Kubernetes removes images on the nodes, and the runner cache has its own limits.
reason.managed_locally: Automatic cleanup is not needed: this is a local Studio, its images are cleaned in Settings, Disk.
reason.runner_disabled: Automatic cleanup is turned off on the runner itself (HSE_RUNNER__DISK_AUTO_CLEAN=false).
